entries.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile for Spring Boot with MySQL. Build stage: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17. Runtime stage: eclipse-temurin:17-jre. Supports JAVA_OPTS env variable for JVM tuning. ENTRYPOINT uses sh -c to expand $JAVA_OPTS at container startup.
decision_rules: Use when language=java, framework=spring_boot, dependencies include mysql
JAVA_OPTS pattern allows tuning heap/GC flags without rebuilding the image
tradeoffs: sh -c entrypoint adds a shell process but enables env var expansion in JAVA_OPTS
No non-root user defined — add USER directive before ENTRYPOINT for production hardening
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode MYSQL_PASSWORD or connection URL in the Dockerfile
Do not use a JDK image in the runtime stage
